Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management (IAM) Manager _ Manager Information Technology to join Infrastructure Services -CAT IT Division The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Manager is responsible for leading a global offshore IAM delivery team supporting enterprise identity, access governance, privileged access management, authentication, authorization, and access lifecycle processes. This role manages a team of IAM analysts, engineers, and third-party resources while ensuring the secure, compliant, and efficient delivery of IAM services aligned with enterprise cybersecurity objectives. The successful candidate will possess broad knowledge across IAM domains, strong people leadership capabilities, operational management experience, and the ability to drive continuous improvement across IAM processes and technologies . The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield PSN Office, Bangalore -KA What you will do Team Leadership & Resource Management Lead, coach, and develop an offshore team of IAM analysts, engineers, and contractors. Manage workload distribution, resource planning, capacity management, and delivery commitments. Establish performance goals, monitor team productivity, and drive operational excellence. Partner with onshore leadership and business stakeholders to ensure alignment of priorities and outcomes. Support hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and succession planning activities. IAM Operations & Service Delivery Oversee day-to-day IAM operations including: User provisioning and deprovisioning Joiner, mover, and leaver processes Access requests and approvals Access certifications and reviews Privileged access management (PAM) Directory services and identity lifecycle management Ensure adherence to established service levels and operational metrics. Drive incident resolution and problem management for IAM-related issues. Governance, Risk & Compliance Support enterprise IAM governance and compliance initiatives. Ensure timely execution of access certifications and access reviews. Partner with audit, compliance, and security teams to address findings and remediation activities. Monitor adherence to security policies, regulatory requirements, and cybersecurity standards. Technology & Continuous Improvement Maintain working knowledge of enterprise IAM platforms and technologies. Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, and operational efficiency. Support implementation and modernization of IAM tools, workflows, and integrations. Participate in strategic IAM initiatives and roadmap execution. Stakeholder Management Serve as a key liaison between cybersecurity, infrastructure, application teams, and business stakeholders. Communicate operational status, risks, and performance metrics to leadership. Build strong partnerships to drive adoption of IAM controls and best practices. What you will have Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field. 7+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, Cybersecurity, or Information Security. 3+ years of people management experience leading global or offshore teams. Strong understanding of: Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) Access Certification Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Privileged Access Management (PAM) Active Directory / Entra ID Single Sign-On (SSO) Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Federation and Directory Services User Lifecycle Management Experience managing vendors, contractors, and managed service providers. Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office. Shift Timing:06:00PM -03:00AM IST(US Shift) Preferred Qualifications CISSP, CISM, CIAM, CGEIT, or relevant IAM certifications. Experience with Sail Point, Saviynt, Cyber Ark, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping Identity, or similar IAM platforms. Experience operating in Agile and product-based delivery models. Experience supporting large global enterprises. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst _IT Analyst Applications to join Infrastructure Services -CAT IT Division The Identity & Access Management (IAM) Analyst is responsible for supporting the day-to-day administration of user identities, access requests, and security controls across enterprise systems and applications. The role ensures users receive appropriate access to perform their job responsibilities while maintaining compliance with company security policies, regulatory requirements, and access governance standards. The IAM Analyst will work closely with business users, application owners, IT teams, cybersecurity teams, and IAM leadership to support identity lifecycle management and access governance processes in a timely and secure manner. The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield PSN Office, Bangalore -KA What you will do Access Administration Process user provisioning, deprovisioning, and access modification requests. Execute Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) activities according to established procedures. Validate access approvals and ensure compliance with access control standards. Support role assignments and entitlement management across enterprise applications. Assist with privileged account administration activities. Identity Lifecycle Support Maintain user accounts in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and other IAM platforms. Monitor onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure timely access changes. Coordinate with HR, managers, and application owners regarding access requirements. Perform routine user account reviews and clean-up activities. Governance & Compliance Support periodic access certification and review activities. Assist with audit requests by gathering access-related evidence and documentation. Ensure all activities comply with organizational security policies and regulatory requirements. Escalate access control concerns, policy violations, or security risks as identified. Incident & Service Support Respond to IAM-related tickets and user support requests. Troubleshoot account lockouts, authentication issues, access failures, and provisioning errors. Escalate complex issues to senior team members when required. Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, resolutions, and support activities. Continuous Improvement Follow established IAM processes, standards, and procedures. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and user experience. Contribute to knowledge base articles and process documentation. Participate in IAM projects, testing activities, and system implementations as needed. Key Skills & Knowledge The successful candidate should have knowledge of: User Access Management Identity Lifecycle Management Active Directory Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) Single Sign-On (SSO) Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Access Governance Principles Service Now or ITSM platforms Information Security Fundamentals What you will have Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management, IT Operations, Service Desk, Systems Administration, or Information Security. Experience managing user accounts and access permissions in enterprise environments. Basic understanding of information security principles and access controls. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent customer service and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple requests while maintaining accuracy and compliance. This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office. Shift Timing:06:00PM -03:00AM IST(US Shift) Preferred Qualifications Experience with one or more IAM solutions such as Sail Point, Saviynt, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Cyber Ark, or Ping Identity. Familiarity with access certification and governance processes. Exposure to SOX, GDPR, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or other regulatory compliance requirements. Microsoft SC-300, Security+, or similar security certifications. Experience supporting global organizations and geographically distributed users Skills desired: Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge: • Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications. • Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities. • Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals. • Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems. • Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function. Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge: • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives. • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder. • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information. • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution. • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems. Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design. Level Extensive Experience: • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications. • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements. • Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design. • Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution. • Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions. • Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications. Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design). Level Working Knowledge: • Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software. • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software. • Drafts application software usage for the department's needs. • Provides instant support for end users of application software. • Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge: • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements. • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis. • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements. • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements. • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis. System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms. Level Working Knowledge: • Assists with current and planned integration initiatives. • Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration. • Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms. • Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area. • Plays an active role in local integration efforts. We are seeking an experienced Electrical/Electronics Systems Engineer to lead the design, development, and integration of complex electrical systems for power conversion and distribution systems in electrified platforms. This role emphasizes system architecture, PCB-level design, advanced component selection, EMI/EMC compliance, and power filter design, including LCL filters. The successful candidate will collaborate across cross-functional teams to deliver robust, compliant, and optimized systems, ensuring strong performance across electrical, thermal, electromagnetic, and packaging domains. Key Responsibilities Define system architecture for power conversion and distribution systems, translating product requirements into subsystem and PCB-level specifications. Lead the design and development of LV/HV power conversion systems, including AC/DC, DC/DC, and inverter-based architectures. Own PCB architecture decisions such as stack-up, partitioning, grounding strategy, and creepage/clearance for high-reliability, EMI-resilient designs. Drive component selection at both system and PCB levels, including power semiconductors, magnetics, passives, and protection devices, with consideration for derating, cost, and lifecycle. Ensure EMI/EMC compliance through effective PCB design practices, filtering, shielding, and system-level noise mitigation strategies. Design, size, and integrate LCL and input/output filters for power converters, including resonance control and damping approaches. Partner with firmware, controls, mechanical, and manufacturing teams to achieve seamless end-to-end system integration. Define and execute verification and validation activities, including EMI testing, power quality evaluation, and system-level debugging. Perform simulation and analysis using SPICE and related tools to validate switching behavior, power integrity, efficiency, and overall robustness. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards such as IEC, CISPR, UL, and CE, and deliver complete design documentation, technical reviews, and validation reports. Technical Skills System architecture and requirements engineering LV and HV system design for batteries, power distribution, and power electronics EMI/EMC design, compliance, and mitigation techniques LCL filter design, resonance control, and filter integration Component selection, including magnetics, passives, and EMI-related components Analog and digital circuit design Power electronics fundamentals and converter topologies System-level validation, debugging, and EMI/EMC test execution Magnetics design expertise, including inductors, chokes, and filters Thermal design considerations for power electronics and filtering hardware Tools and Software ECAD tools: Altium, Or CAD, and Cadence Simulation tools: LTSpice, PSpice, and MATLAB/Simulink EMI test equipment: spectrum analyzers, EMI receivers, and LISN setups Validation tools: oscilloscopes, CANoe, and related lab instrumentation Requirements management tools such as DOORS or Polarion are a plus Soft Skills and Teamwork Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation practices Clear communication and effective collaboration across cross-functional teams Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to schedule Proactive problem-solving mindset with a commitment to continuous learning Qualifications Master’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering with 6+ years of relevant experience Ph.D. in Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, or a related field with 3+ years of relevant experience Experience in electrification, automotive, or industrial power systems is preferred Additional Information: This job required 5days working from Office. title: Parts Information Graphics Specialist
jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Summary In TIS, the Parts Information Graphics Specialist is responsible for the creation, accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of 3D models utilized for navigation and within dealer-facing applications utilized by service personnel in the field for parts ordering, troubleshooting, service repair, etc. What You Will Do: Create and optimize lightweight high-quality 3D models in a timely and efficient manner meeting production targets. Access CAD files and build into complete product model files to cover systems including hydraulic, electrical, air conditioning, powertrain, and engine. Identify and reuse "like or similar" components ensuring maximum productivity of graphics creation processes utilizing geometry that has already been optimized. Evaluate new graphics technologies and/or help define requirements for the development of new tools and processes that support the creation of 3D graphics for dealer-facing applications. What You Have: Technical Excellence: Demonstrated knowledge of Caterpillar product structure, engineering databases (Teamcenter, PRWB), modeling & rendering tools (Autodesk 3DS Max and various CAD software). Effective Communication: Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own performance effectiveness. Independently makes oral presentations and written reports needed for own work. Leads meetings and teams effectively. Collaboration & Engagement: Ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with peers and other relevant stakeholders. Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date). This is a lead role
- responsible for developing and maintaining high-quality 3D CAD models, engineering drawings, BOM structures, and product data while ensuring compliance with Caterpillar engineering standards, quality requirements, and release processes Responsibilities of a Modelling & Detailing Lead Engineer Create and review 3D CAD models (Creo) Ensure high-quality 2D engineering drawings and GD&T compliance. Support product development, NPI, CPI, and engineering change activities. Drive drawing quality, release quality, and standards compliance. Mentor engineers on modelling best practices and detailing methodologies. Coordinate with Design Control Engineers, Offshore & Quality teams. Support BOM creation, Teamcenter data management, and release processes. Drive productivity improvements, automation, and standardization of modelling/detailing processes. Skills Expected Expert proficiency in Creo Modelling & Detailing. GD&T and engineering drawing interpretation. Ability to validate drawings Teamcenter product data management (BNU, JT Creation, & TCE debug fix) BOM generation and configuration management. Strong problem-solving and project coordination skills. Coaching and mentoring capability. Communication and stakeholder management. Level Basic Understanding: • Identifies information capture needs in own area. • Describes key benefits, drawbacks and rationale for documenting relevant information. • Provides examples of the risks associated with failing to record relevant information. • Explains organizational methods for documenting, identifying and recording information. Level Basic Understanding: • Compiles current research relevant to standard operating procedures. • Explains usage of standard operating procedures in business operations. • Describes main issues and considerations when using standard operating procedures. • Identifies key features and functions of standard operating procedures. Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Basic Understanding: • Names specific tools or techniques that can be used to support the analytical thinking process. • Describes specific software applications or products used for business analytics. • Gives examples of how analytical thinking has been used to resolve problems. • Helps others research and learn more about business analytics tools and applications. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Basic Understanding: • Describes non-verbal behaviors that influence the interpretation of the message. • Cites examples of effective and ineffective communications. • Explains the importance of effective business communication. • Speaks/writes using correct language, mechanics, and gestures. Design for Manufacturability (DFM): Knowledge of design for manufacturability guidelines, methodologies, and use cases; ability to use this knowledge to optimize product designs and manufacturing operations. Level Basic Understanding: • Discusses the use cases, benefits, and importance of DFM. • Explains the key DFM design principles. • Lists the major tools and technologies used for implementing DFM methodologies. • Locates the DFM guidelines for various types of manufacturing processes within the organization. Engineering
- MFG: Knowledge of processes, techniques and methods of engineering in a manufacturing environment; ability to design and implement materials, structures, machines, devices, systems and processes that safely realize a desired objective or invention. Level Basic Understanding: • Describes where and how to obtain additional engineering information and expertise. • Explains engineering concepts and features in a manufacturing environment. • Cites manufacturing industry or organizational examples of usage or application of engineering. • Identifies major initiatives, key issues and benefits of engineering in manufacturing. Product Testing: Knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques and tools; ability to design, plan and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure product quality at all stages of manufacturing. Level Basic Understanding: • Describes key features and aspects of a specific testing discipline or methodology. • Describes common errors that are uncovered by product testing. • Cites examples of testing tools and practices currently in use. • Names key documentation (paper, audio, video) required during the testing process. Troubleshooting Technical Problems: Knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect and resolve technical problems in a manufacturing or product development environment. Level Basic Understanding: • Explains where to locate basic help facilities and troubleshooting guides. • Discusses basic concepts behind a systematic approach to solving technical problems. • Identifies available resources and support systems for troubleshooting. • Describes problem identification, reporting and escalation procedures. Mechanical Structural Engineer – E+ES (Battery and Power systems) Role Overview Mechanical Structural Engineer responsible for design, analysis, and product realization of battery systems and power electronics for energy and power applications. The role focuses on ensuring structural integrity, electrical packaging compliance, vibration robustness, and manufacturable designs under defined loading conditions, thermal environments, and boundary constraints. Key Responsibilities Structural Design & Analysis:
- Define load cases and boundary conditions based on vibration inputs, shock events, G-loads, and operating conditions
- Perform linear and nonlinear FEA: static, modal, random vibration (PSD), fatigue, thermo-mechanical, and drop impact analysis
- Evaluate handling scenarios including lifting and transportation loads as per standards
- Design sheet metal, Casting and Extrusion based structures
- Execute weld design considering fatigue strength, HAZ effects, and distortion
- Perform bolted joint analysis (preload, clamp retention, fatigue, sealing compression)
- Develop isolation mount (iso-mount) models for vibration isolation and resonance control
- Incorporate thermal solutions including Coolant pipes, HV -LV harnessing and auxiliary systems in the design keeping serviceability in mind Packaging & Electrical Integration:
- Develop 3D packaging layouts considering space claim, clearances, and serviceability
- Define creepage and clearance distances for high-voltage systems in compliance with applicable standards
- Ensure compliance with electrical insulation, dielectric spacing, and safety requirements (IEC/UL/ISO)
- Incorporate EMI/EMC considerations, sealing (IP ratings), and thermal paths in packaging Caterpillar: Confidential Green
- Work with electrical teams with intermediate-level exposure to harness design including routing constraints, bend radii, connector interfaces, and protection requirements
- Optimize packaging for thermal dissipation and structural support Design Definition & Controls:
- Apply GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and perform tolerance stack-up analysis
- Select materials based on mechanical, thermal, electrical insulation, and corrosion properties (e.g., Galvanic corrosion) Manufacturing Integration:
- Implement DFM/DFA for manufacturability and assembly robustness and process selection (sheet metal forming, welding, casting, molding)
- Address variation, distortion, and residual stress
- Support DV/PV builds and CAE correlation Quality & Product Development:
- Execute DFMEA/PFMEA with structured risk mitigation
- Drive APQP deliverables across development phases
- Manage PPAP requirements Supplier Technical Engagement:
- Evaluate supplier capability in part quality, fabrication, welding, and dimensional control
- Validate tooling and process capability
- Lead technical reviews and issue resolution Failure Analysis & Optimization:
- Perform root cause analysis (stress correlation, fracture, test vs CAE)
- Correlate strain, vibration, and thermal data with simulation
- Optimize designs for fatigue life, stiffness efficiency, and cost

title: IS Specialist - Senior Data Modeler
jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. About Caterpillar Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed to and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed. Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled IS Specialist -Senior Data Modeler to join India Co E-Integration & Engg -CAT IT Division We are seeking a Senior Data Modeler to serve as the architectural steward of the Caterpillar Financial Insurance Services (CFIS) Snowflake data warehouse. This role is the connective tissue between insurance business leaders, source-system SMEs, ETL engineers, BI developers, and AI/analytics platforms — translating complex insurance business processes into governed, scalable, business-friendly data models that power certified reporting, self-service analytics, Snowflake Intelligence, and downstream AI agents. The ideal candidate combines deep technical modeling craft with relentless curiosity about how insurance data is actually created, moved, and consumed — someone who won't stop at "what the source system sends" but instead digs in with policy administration, claims, actuarial, and underwriting to understand why the data looks the way it does, and how it should be shaped to answer the business's most important questions. The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN What you will do End-to-End Data Modeling & Data Product Ownership: Lead the full data modeling lifecycle for the CFIS Snowflake warehouse — from business requirements discovery, conceptual → logical → physical design, entity-relationship mapping, dimensional modeling (Kimball star/snowflake schemas, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions), through iterative validation. Own the models as data products with clear consumers, SLAs, and lifecycle governance in collaboration with onshore data modelers. Investigative Source-System Analysis (Curiosity in Action): Serve as the team's most curious mind when it comes to bringing in data from source systems. This role requires actively digging into CFIS-specific insurance, broader Caterpillar systems, and external sources. You'll partner with source-system owners and business SMEs to understand data lineage, business rules, edge cases, and historical anomalies before proposing how the data should be modeled — not just consuming feeds as-is. Insurance Business Fluency & Stakeholder Engagement: Build and continuously deepen your knowledge of insurance business processes — policy lifecycle, premium calculation and earning patterns, physical damage vs. extended protection product lines, claims adjudication and reserving, loss ratios, and actuarial reserving concepts. Directly engage insurance business leadership — including CFIS product managers, actuarial, claims, underwriting, and Insurance Services executives — to understand data requirements, translate business questions into modeling decisions, and validate that certified data sources reflect real-world business intent. Snowflake-Native Modeling & Semantic Layer Design: Design models that leverage Snowflake's architecture — clustering keys, micro-partitioning, materialized views, dynamic tables, transient/temporary tables, zero-copy cloning, and secure data sharing — for query performance, storage efficiency, and cost-aware scalability. Own the certified semantic layer on top of the warehouse that powers Power BI dashboards, Snowflake Semantic Views, Snowflake Intelligence, and Streamlit apps. Metric, Grain & Business Glossary Stewardship: Define and document business metrics, measures, and grain at each layer of the model (raw → conformed → presentation → semantic). Own CFIS business glossary alignment, ensuring metrics like "written premium," "earned premium," "incurred loss," "loss ratio," and "policy count" have single, certified definitions that hold across Power BI, Snowflake Intelligence, and AI agent consumption. Governance, Standards & Documentation: Establish and enforce modeling standards — naming conventions, surrogate/natural key strategies, reference data management, data classification (PII/PHI-sensitive claims data), and end-to-end lineage documentation. Champion data contracts between source systems and the warehouse to reduce silent breakage. Data Quality, Integrity & Reconciliation: Embed validation rules, referential integrity checks, and completeness/consistency expectations into model designs. Partner with ETL developers and data stewards to identify and resolve upstream data quality issues rather than masking them at the reporting layer. Matillion ETL/ELT Alignment: Collaborate closely with the ETL team to ensure modeling decisions align with pipeline implementation. Advise on tradeoffs between normalization, denormalization, and performance — balancing model integrity with practical load, refresh, and incremental-merge patterns. Offshore Delivery & Cross-Team Collaboration: Operate effectively in an offshore delivery model, partnering daily with onshore architecture, ETL developers, team leads, BI developers, BAs, PMs, and insurance business leadership in Nashville, TN. Coordinate with other data modelers to share reusable modeling patterns and ensure consistent definitions across domains — policy administration, claims, premium, dealer solutions, pricing, and reinsurance. Scalability & Forward-Looking Architecture: Proactively evaluate model designs for scalability as new data sources, business domains, and AI/self-service use cases emerge. Recommend refactoring or extension strategies that preserve backward compatibility while enabling growth (e.g., preparing for Snowflake Semantic Views, Cortex Analyst, AI integrations). Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing: Mentor junior modelers, ETL developers, and BI developers on dimensional modeling craft and insurance domain knowledge. Participate in CAB reviews, contribute to weekly release notes, maintain model documentation, and support onboarding of new team members. What you will have 7+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or data modeling, with at least 4 years in a dedicated data modeler or data architect role Expert-level proficiency in dimensional modeling (Kimball methodology), entity-relationship modeling, and hybrid approaches (Data Vault familiarity a plus) 3+ years hands-on with Snowflake — schema design, clustering strategies, performance tuning, secure data sharing, and Snowflake-native features Advanced SQL skills — ability to profile, validate, and troubleshoot data at scale across complex joins and business logic Demonstrated ability to engage business leaders — translating ambiguous business questions into concrete modeling decisions and communicating tradeoffs in business-friendly language Strong investigative mindset — comfort digging into source systems, tracing data lineage, and asking "why does the data look this way?" before designing solutions Excellent written and verbal communication — able to produce clear model documentation, business glossary entries, and executive-facing decision briefs Proven ability to work effectively in an offshore delivery model, collaborating daily with onshore architecture, ETL, and business teams across time zones Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, or related field (or equivalent experience) Preferred Insurance or financial services data background — particularly with policy administration, claims, premium, actuarial, or financial reporting data Familiarity with Matillion ETL/ELT and understanding of how modeling decisions impact pipeline design and orchestration Experience with Power BI semantic models, DAX, and how modeling decisions flow through to dashboard consumption Exposure to Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowflake Intelligence / Polaris AI, or AI-ready semantic view design — including experience preparing data for natural language query and AI agent consumption Familiarity with data governance frameworks (data classification, masking policies, row access policies), metadata management, and Snowflake lineage tools Experience with Git version control, CI/CD for data warehouse artifacts, and environment management (dev/test/prod) Snowflake certifications (Snow Pro Core, Snow Pro Advanced: Data Engineer or Architect) Familiarity with insurance-specific concepts: written vs. earned premium, IBNR, loss development, subrogation, reinsurance, physical damage vs. extended protection product lines ted This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office. Level Expert: • Gains agreement on the problem-solving process, risk assessment, decision points, and criteria. • Trains others in the process of eliciting alternatives and assessing their impact. • Orchestrates the resolution of high-impact and cross-functional problems. • Successfully organizes problem solvers and stakeholders for high-impact problems. • Predicts and explains long-term trends and implications for alternatives. • Monitors industry for best practices and new techniques in problem-solving. Level Expert: • Advises others on the technical design of high-impact, multi-technology complex applications. • Contributes to the establishment and implementation of best practices for application design. • Leads in evaluating and selecting emerging application design tools and techniques. • Designs cutting-edge application architectures that push the boundaries of current technology standards. • Directs the development of technical standards for application design. • Fosters a culture that promotes innovative approaches to application design and architecture. Level Expert: • Consults with others on system and/or technology integration efforts. • Monitors system and technology integration trends and directions. • Plays a leadership role in defining systems integration processes and practices. • Designs complex interfaces, integration strategies and plans. • Holds an industry wide conference on system integration and migration issues, problems and considerations. • Demonstrates extensive experience with system and technology integration. title: Senior Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. The Strategic Procurement and Planning Division (SPPD) is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join the AI Mission Team, partnering with enterprise AI Accelerator teams and business leaders to deliver next-generation AI-enabled solutions. This role is responsible for transforming high-priority supply chain, procurement, and planning challenges into scalable AI prototypes, agentic workflows, and production-ready solution patterns. You will design and implement solutions leveraging machine learning, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and workflow automation, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, and security standards. This position blends deep technical expertise with strong business partnership to accelerate digital transformation and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in AI application development, Python, APIs, data integration, and responsible AI practices, along with the ability to prototype rapidly and scale solutions globally. What you will do: AI Solution Development Design, prototype, build, test, and deploy AI-enabled applications and internal tools using Python, Streamlit, APIs, and modern AI frameworks Deliver scalable AI/ML solutions that solve complex business problems across procurement, planning, and supply chain Agentic AI & Workflow Automation Develop agent-based workflows, tool integrations, and human-in-the-loop processes Automate operational decision-making workflows to drive efficiency and scalability Data Management & RAG Systems Implement RAG, Graph RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and knowledge graph solutions Enable AI applications to retrieve and reason over trusted enterprise data sources Governance, Evaluation & Responsible AI Apply AI governance practices including model evaluation, prompt/version tracking, PII masking, guardrails, and cost monitoring Ensure compliance with enterprise data security, privacy, and risk management standards Data Engineering & Analytics Enablement Design and automate pipelines for structured and unstructured data from enterprise and legacy systems Support scalable data ingestion, transformation, and integration frameworks Business Partnership & Requirements Analysis Partner with product owners, SMEs, and digital teams to translate business problems into AI/ML prototypes and scalable solutions Define success criteria, KPIs, and measurable outcomes for AI initiatives What skills you have: Programming Languages: Knowledge of programming concepts and software development practices; ability to write, test, and maintain code in Python and integrate with APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms. Builds and deploys AI-enabled applications, automation workflows, and agent-based solutions, integrating large language models (LLMs), vector databases, and enterprise systems while ensuring secure data handling and scalable architecture. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques for eliciting, analyzing, and documenting business and technical requirements for successful solution delivery. Translates business problems into AI/ML use cases, prototypes, and scalable solution patterns, defining measurable success criteria and aligning outputs to enterprise strategy and operational outcomes. Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine root cause, evaluate alternatives, and recommend practical solutions. Applies structured problem-solving to design and evaluate AI-driven approaches (e.g., automation, LLM-based solutions, agentic workflows) and determine the most effective and scalable path forward. Business Statistics: Knowledge of statistical tools, processes, and practices to describe business results in measurable scales; ability to use statistical methods to support business decisions. Supports model validation, experimentation, and performance evaluation, ensuring AI/ML outputs are reliable, measurable, and aligned to business KPIs. Machine Learning: Knowledge of machine learning principles, algorithms, and evaluation methods; ability to develop, implement, and improve AI/ML-enabled solutions. Designs and delivers solutions using advanced machine learning, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and model evaluation techniques, incorporating responsible AI practices such as bias awareness, model monitoring, guardrails, and performance optimization. Top candidates will also have: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field Advanced degrees preferred with focus on AI, machine learning, or applied data science disciplines Experience with agentic AI frameworks, tool-using LLMs, and orchestration platforms Proven experience building AI-powered internal tools or full-stack applications (e.g., Fast API, Streamlit, modern web frameworks, containers) Hands-on experience with RAG, Graph RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, or knowledge graph solutions Experience integrating legacy enterprise systems with modern data platforms and APIs Experience implementing AI governance practices, including model evaluation, prompt/version tracking, PII masking, guardrails, and cost monitoring Demonstrated ability to automate business processes and improve operational workflows using AI and data Background in supply chain, procurement, manufacturing, or enterprise operations analytics This position requires working onsite five days a week. Relocation is available for this position. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates: July 28, 2026

jobDescription:

About the Electric Power Division Caterpillar's Electric Power Division (EPD) offers integrated solutions, parts, and services to meet the needs of our various commercial and industrial electric power customers. EPD supports a wide range of customer applications across the globe, including providing back-up power to hospitals, providing emergency power when natural disasters strike, and supporting critical infrastructure for data centers, municipalities, and more. Role Definition: As a Field Service Engineer at Caterpillar, you will provide technical support of field startups and integration of distributed energy sources both standard and non-standard Hybrid/Custom Power Solutions, switchgear systems, remedial repairs and preventative maintenance in assigned territory. jobDescription:

Job Summary Provides technical leadership in applying Data Science, AI, and Machine Learning to transform large-scale data into actionable insights, intelligent automation, and business value across Packaging and related enterprise functions. What You Will Do Lead the design, development, deployment, and optimization of AI/ML, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative AI solutions to address complex Packaging, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Engineering challenges. Direct large-scale data gathering, data mining, feature engineering, and data processing activities; create scalable data models and data pipelines. Explore, promote, and implement AI-driven capabilities using LLMs, Agentic AI Frameworks, NLP, semantic search, and advanced analytics techniques. Drive development and deployment of predictive, optimization, quality, sustainability, and automation solutions using machine learning and data science methodologies. Lead definition of business requirements, analytical scope, and solution architecture; translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. Collaborate with stakeholders, conduct workshops, and communicate actionable insights through dashboards, visualizations, and executive presentations. Establish MLOps, model governance, monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement processes to ensure reliable production deployment of AI solutions. Conduct research and evaluation of emerging AI technologies, algorithms, and frameworks to improve solution effectiveness and business impact. What You Have Business Partnership & Requirements Analysis Knowledge of business analysis techniques and stakeholder engagement practices; ability to translate business needs into scalable data science and AI solutions. Level: Extensive Experience Engages with business leaders, clients, and stakeholders to understand strategic priorities. Leads workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and solution discovery activities. Defines analytical scope, success criteria, and technical requirements for AI initiatives. Translates complex business challenges into data science, machine learning, and automation solutions. Effectively communicates technical concepts to executive, technical, and business audiences. Partners with cross-functional teams to drive adoption and business value realization. Query & Database Access Tools Knowledge of data management systems and data access technologies; ability to retrieve, transform, and optimize enterprise data for analytics and AI applications. Level: Extensive Experience Writes, optimizes, and supports complex SQL queries across multiple databases and data sources. Works extensively with structured and unstructured data environments. Designs data retrieval and transformation strategies supporting AI and analytics workloads. Consults on query optimization, performance tuning, and database best practices. Utilizes big data technologies and distributed data processing frameworks. Evaluates database technologies and architectures supporting AI initiatives. Data Analysis & Statistical Modeling Knowledge of statistical methods, predictive analytics, and data-driven decision-making; ability to transform data into meaningful business insights. Level: Working Experience Performs advanced statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning experimentation. Uses statistical techniques to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and business opportunities. Translates complex analytical findings into actionable business recommendations. Develops metrics, KPIs, and analytical frameworks to support strategic decisions. Evaluates model accuracy, effectiveness, and business impact using statistical methodologies. Communicates analytical insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Knowledge of machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, computer vision, and agentic frameworks; ability to develop, deploy, and manage AI-based solutions that drive business outcomes. Level: Working knowledge Leads the design and deployment of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative AI solutions. Develops and implements LLM-based applications utilizing Agentic AI, NLP, embeddings, summarization, and semantic search technologies. Selects, trains, evaluates, and optimizes models using Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Scikit-Learn, Py Spark MLlib, and related frameworks. Monitors model performance and implements retraining, scalability, and error-handling strategies. Coaches and mentors teams on AI technologies, methodologies, and best practices. Applies AI solutions to solve complex packaging, logistics, engineering, and supply chain business challenges. Programming Languages & Software Development Knowledge of programming concepts, software development practices, and application development frameworks; ability to build scalable AI-enabled applications and enterprise solutions. Level: Working Experience Demonstrates expertise in Python, SQL, Py Spark, Apache Spark, APIs, and distributed computing technologies. Develops scalable AI applications using Streamlit, Gradio, and cloud-native architectures. Integrates AI services with enterprise business systems and backend platforms. Implements software engineering best practices, code reviews, testing frameworks, and CI/CD processes. Guides teams in selecting development tools, frameworks, and coding standards. Oversees development activities ensuring quality, maintainability, and performance. Cloud & Data Engineering Knowledge of cloud platforms, data engineering practices, and enterprise-scale distributed systems; ability to design and implement scalable AI and analytics solutions. Level: Working Knowledge Designs and deploys end-to-end distributed solutions on Azure, AWS, Databricks, and cloud-native environments. Works with relational and non-relational databases, data warehouses, big data platforms, and caching technologies. Develops and optimizes large-scale data pipelines and feature engineering workflows. Utilizes cloud-native architectures to support AI, analytics, and automation solutions. Implements scalable data processing and storage solutions supporting enterprise AI systems. Evaluates emerging cloud technologies and recommends improvements. MLOps & Production Deployment Knowledge of model lifecycle management, MLOps frameworks, and deployment architectures; ability to operationalize AI solutions at enterprise scale. Level: Working Knowledge Implements MLOps frameworks using MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Azure Dev Ops, and CI/CD pipelines. Builds automated deployment, monitoring, governance, and model management solutions. Ensures scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability of production AI systems. Establishes best practices for version control, collaboration, testing, and deployment. Develops monitoring strategies to track model drift, performance degradation, and operational issues. Drives continuous improvement of AI operations and deployment methodologies. Domain Expertise – Packaging, Supply Chain & Logistics Knowledge of packaging engineering, supply chain, logistics, transportation, procurement, and manufacturing operations; ability to apply AI/ML technologies to business-specific challenges. Level: Working Knowledge Applies AI/ML techniques to packaging, logistics, supply chain, transportation, procurement, and engineering domains. Understands operational workflows, business processes, and optimization opportunities within industrial environments. Develops AI-driven solutions for quality prediction, defect detection, optimization modeling, sustainability, and automation. Leverages domain expertise to accelerate solution adoption and business impact. Collaborates with engineering and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities. Provides technical leadership on AI initiatives supporting Packaging and Supply Chain transformation. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Statistics, or a related discipline. 12+ years of overall professional experience with at least 3+ years in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or Advanced Analytics. Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale AI/ML solutions in production environments. Strong communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and collaboration skills. Continuous learning mindset with relevant certifications in AI, Cloud, Data Engineering, or Analytics preferred. Experience working in Packaging, Supply Chain, Logistics, Transportation, Procurement, or related industrial domains preferred. Flexibility to support global teams and business operations when required. We are seeking a skilled Senior IT Analyst Applications (Senior Azure Cloud Engineer )to join Azure Platform Services -CAT IT Division. We are currently seeking a Senior Azure Cloud Engineer to join the Azure Platform Services team within the Caterpillar Information Technology Division. In this role, you will build, deploy, and operationally support Azure Iaa S solutions on a global scale, with emphasis on SAP workloads. You will act as a technical subject matter expert, contributing to cloud modernization, platform reliability, and automation. This role supports mission‑critical systems, demands strong engineering discipline, and offers opportunities to collaborate with senior architects and cross-functional cloud teams. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking team, apply now. The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield PSN Office, Bangalore, India What you will do Cloud Engineering & Delivery Build, migrate, and manage Microsoft Azure Iaa S solutions, including SAP Workloads, VMs, VNets, App Services, Functions, Databases, Storage, and Integration Services. Deploy or integrate cloud technologies based on business partner requirements using automation-first approaches. Enhance, follow, and contribute to enterprise cloud designs, processes, and governance. Technical Support & Problem Solving Serve as a technical SME for cloud infrastructure and platform services, providing troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance tuning across a complex global network. Support solutions running on Azure and work closely with senior engineers, architects, and global teams. Assist teams with documentation, training, onboarding, and platform usability. Automation & Dev Ops Build automated solutions for infrastructure deployment using Power Shell, Python, YAML, ARM Templates, CI/CD pipelines (Azure Dev Ops / Git Hub), Azure CLI, VBS, Java, Node JS, JSON, Bash, Azure Portal. Contribute to standardized templates, repeatable deployment processes, and Infrastructure‑as‑Code practices. Security, Compliance & Operational Excellence Apply secure-by-design standards, identity best practices (Managed Identity, RBAC, Key Vault), and network security patterns. Participate in LTA (Logical Technical Architecture) reviews, operational excellence practices, and cloud governance alignment. Support monitoring, logging, disaster recovery, backup, and vulnerability remediation. What you will have 7+ years of Azure Cloud experience in application development, cloud operations, or infrastructure engineering. Hands-on expertise with Azure core services: Iaa S (VMs, VNets, NSGs, Load Balancers, Storage, ASR) Experience automating deployments using Power Shell, Python, JSON, YAML, CI/CD, Azure Dev Ops (Microsoft VSTS). Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across distributed systems and global network environments. Experience supporting or building cloud architectures in production environments. Ability to perform development/deployment assignments without close supervision. Ability to work directly on technical problem identification and resolution, including responding to off-shift and weekend support calls. Ability to deploy or integrate infrastructure technology components based on requirements gathered from customers. Ability to perform integrated testing and customer acceptance testing of components that require careful planning and execution to ensure timely, quality results. This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office Top Candidates Will Also Have: Experience with Azure infrastructure operations or applications development, with special emphasis in areas of SAP workloads, networking, DNS, application services, security, distributed computing, databases, and storage Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related information technology degree Azure Certifications such as AZ-120, AZ-900, AZ-104, or AZ-500 Experience using the SCRUM methodology Experience working with IT security on infrastructure or applications security compliance and security vulnerability remediation activities Strong verbal and written communication (English), teamwork, analytical, and interpersonal skills Strong problem solving and customer service skills Skills desired: Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience: • Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients. • Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems. • Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units. • Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units. • Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas. • Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications. Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience: • Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort. • Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts. • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate. • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes. • Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies. • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems. Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design. Level Extensive Experience: • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications. • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements. • Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design. • Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution. • Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions. • Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications. Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design). Level Working Knowledge: • Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software. • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software. • Drafts application software usage for the department's needs. • Provides instant support for end users of application software. • Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Extensive Experience: • Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms. • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage. • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases. • Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation. • Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews. • Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements. System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms. Level Extensive Experience: • Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges. • Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes. • Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative. • Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks. • Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues. • Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies. System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Extensive Experience: • Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices. • Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase. • Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications. • Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations. • Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation. • Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools. Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Working Knowledge: • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems. • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities. • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards. • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting. • Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used. title: Path Planning Senior Autonomy Engineer
jobDescription:
Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. Role Definition Caterpillar’s Autonomy and Automation Group is building the autonomous planning platform that moves machines and manipulates terrain across construction sites. As a Path Planning Engineer, you will design the navigation and terrain planning that lets autonomous machines drive, dig, and dump safely and efficiently — from stationary digging to high-speed machine navigation. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in developing path planning algorithms, perception techniques and implementing production quality software in C++. Responsibilities
1. Develop navigation planning — route generation, path planning over drivable terrain, and obstacle avoidance
2. Build motion planning that issues control commands to accurately track planned paths
3. Design terrain planning that decides where machines engage terrain — dig, dump, and push
4. Deliver long-horizon planning for both onboard and offboard execution
5. Create reusable planning libraries and common data objects such as path geometry and zones
6. Develop search and optimization algorithms and motion & terrain interaction prediction models
7. Develop production quality code and own your algorithms from design to production
8. Run simulation for path planning algorithm development and test various scenarios
9. Test code on construction equipment.
minimumQualification: 1. Bachelor's or Master's in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related engineering field 2. Strong foundation in motion and path planning, including search and sampling-based methods such as A*, RRT, and graph search 3. Proficiency in C++ and/or Python for real-time robotics software 4. Experience with autonomous ground vehicles, mobile robots, or off-road navigation 5. Working knowledge of kinematics, dynamics, and control for path tracking 6. Track record building modular, reusable software libraries with clean interfaces Preferred Qualifications 1. Experience with off-highway or heavy equipment such as excavators, loaders, and trucks 2. Familiarity with terrain modeling and machine-terrain interaction prediction 3. Knowledge of perception, localization, and mapping (SLAM) 4. Exposure to ROS, simulation, and field testing of autonomy Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality. Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.
